recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white close-up portrait of a bearded man wearing a textured top hat, featuring a striking color-selective element where each eye is a different vibrant hue. The composition is centered and symmetrical, overlaid with distressed textures and clean, modern typography that reflects the theme of duality.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome skin tones versus vibrant iris colors
Rough beard and fabric textures versus smooth typographic lines
Symmetrical facial alignment versus asymmetrical eye colors
Dark, vignetted background focusing attention on the central gaze
coreInvariants: Selective color in the irises only
High-contrast black and white base image
Heavy film grain and distressed border textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head and shoulders, filling approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, specifically the contrasting blue and amber irises.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colored eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the central text, then to the beard, and finally to the secondary logo in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounding the head and hat, creating a tight, intimate atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white grayscale for the majority of the image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep amber/orange for the right eye and warm-toned text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright teal/cyan for the left eye and cool-toned text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the small iris areas against zero saturation in the background; high value contrast in facial highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '+' symbol acts as a central divider between the two color-coded words.

composition.position: Centered horizontally across the bridge of the nose

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modern geometric sans-serif for the title paired with a highly decorative, vintage-inspired lockup for the secondary branding.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure matches the modern duality theme.
Classic geometric proportions provide a timeless feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with a full beard and a textured top hat. The lighting should be dramatic, coming from the sides to emphasize facial texture. One eye should be bright cyan and the other bright amber. Apply a heavy film grain and a distressed, scratched border effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the center of the face. The first half of the text should be amber, and the second half should be teal, separated by a small plus sign. In the bottom right corner, add a decorative, vintage-style circular typographic badge in light gray.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait strictly monochrome except for the eyes?
Is the text centered and legible against the facial details?
Are the eye colors distinct (one cool, one warm)?
Does the border have a weathered, vintage film aesthetic?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the artist
Unique jewelry details on the hat

mustAchieve: Rich black values in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in the facial alignment.
Ensure the selective color does not bleed into the eyelids.
Verify the distressed border does not obscure the main text.
Confirm the two distinct typographic styles do not clash.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-contrast B&W portrait + Add two-tone selective color to eyes + Overlay wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text in matching colors + Frame with distressed film textures.
